hardware: RTX 4080, Intel i7-14700K, four P cores (0,2,4,6), driver 595.71.05
protocol: Two alternating A/B rounds per input bucket, 1000 timings/run, one process/engine, four CPU threads, warm model and filesystem caches, TF32 disabled. Every run checks all 100 reference cases before timing. GPU/OS shared with existing desktop applications; no other session was stopped. No own builds overlapped timing.
correctness: All 100 reference decisions match. Maximum native raw-logit error 3.814697265625e-6. Separate repeated GPU kernel and full-model tests cover masks, local boundaries, all-masked rows, and graph replay across mixed sequence lengths.
native_execution: All tensor computation runs on CUDA. Persistent buffers; uint8 embedding table; exact-erf GeGLU; f32 cuBLAS and attention; combined heads. Last layer computes only the query/output row consumed by first-token pooling. Batched GEMMs implement long attention. CUDA graphs use a 64-length LRU cache; first use of a length captures a graph. Only int32 token IDs/masks and 22 f32 logits cross the host boundary.
build: Rust 1.97.1, release opt3/thin-LTO/codegen-units1/debug0; features ort,native-cuda. CUDA 13.2 compiler, ORT 1.28.0, cuDNN 9.20.0.48; eager module/data loading.
source_note: Runs record the implementation commit and uncommitted documentation/report paths. Exact source hashes identify the tested implementation; later rebases can change the commit ID without changing these sources.
